events.event: Polri's Bareskrim named Presidential Chief of Staff and former Kapolri Listyo Sigit Prabowo, Kadivkum Irjen Ahrie Sonta and Irjen Eko Hadi Santoso suspects in alleged illegal wiretapping of President Prabowo's number and others, and detained them at the Mabes Polri detention centre.
events.key_numbers: 3 suspects · wiretapping period 2025-2026 · alleged log-deletion order Oct 2026 · police report filed 30 Oct 2026 · 10 witnesses + 3 experts · seized 11 phones, 1 iPad, 4 flashdisks · Art. 258 KUHP (max 10 yrs), Art. 332 KUHP (max 6 yrs), Art. 32(1) UU ITE (max 8 yrs)
events.why_it_matters: The head of the President's staff office and a former police chief are accused of tapping the President's own phone; no Istana response found yet.
events.spreading_evidence: Multiple outlets (Kompas, detik, CNN Indonesia) ran it as top story 3 Nov evening

events.event: Ex-Jampidsus Febrie Adriansyah denied before the Jakarta Tipikor Court that he extorted businessman Tan Kian for Rp55 billion, after Tan Kian and Ferry 'Boboho' testified that money was demanded to avoid suspect status in the Jiwasraya case; judges removed two spectators accused of leaking testimony.
events.key_numbers: Rp55 billion alleged extortion · prosecution evidence shown in court · witness Boboho earlier cited Rp50 billion demand and Rp22.5 billion fee · hearing 2-3 Nov 2026
events.why_it_matters: A former top Kejaksaan Agung prosecutor is on trial over alleged extortion linked to the Jiwasraya case.
events.spreading_evidence: detik news page: 10+ headlines on the trial in 12 hours

events.event: PKB's Muhammad Khozin said the faction is seriously studying DPR options (interpelasi, hak angket, hak menyatakan pendapat) after MA cassation ruling 742 K/TUN/2026 voided Gibran's SMA-equivalence letter; PDIP said it cannot push an angket alone, Demokrat said Gibran no longer qualifies, Golkar said it will study the full ruling.
events.key_numbers: MA ruling 742 K/TUN/2026 · voided suket No. 9149/D.D1/KS/2019 dated 6 Aug 2019 · Art. 79(3) and 79(4)c UU MD3 · DPR in recess until 9 Nov 2026
events.why_it_matters: Explains what DPR can actually do next about the Vice President's diploma ruling.
events.spreading_evidence: detik and CNN Indonesia front-page items 2-3 Nov

events.event: KPK chair Setyo Budiyanto said ATR/BPN Minister Nusron Wahid will be summoned as a witness 'soon' in the Summarecon HGB bribery case after he missed two summonses; KPK asked him to prioritise it amid unverified reports of a Japan trip.
events.key_numbers: Summons skipped 7 Oct and 15 Oct 2026 · 8 suspects named · OTT 14 Sep: 19 people caught, Rp106.3 billion cash seized
events.why_it_matters: A sitting minister has twice skipped a KPK summons; Nusron is not named a suspect.

events.event: KPK spokesperson Budi Prasetyo said the PT Djarum excise-stamp probe concerns alleged underpayment of cukai through affiliated companies; searches also covered Semarang customs and the Central Java customs regional office, with money found at customs offices; no suspects named.
events.key_numbers: Sprindik umum Oct 2026 · state loss 'hitungan awal triliunan' · 6 affiliated companies searched 29 Oct · no witnesses summoned yet (2 Nov)
events.why_it_matters: Cigarette excise is a big state revenue source; Djarum says it is cooperative and obeys the law.

events.event: Polri's Bareskrim named 13 suspects (including two Russians and one Ukrainian) in five trafficking cases that lured 58 Indonesians, some ex-TNI/Polri, to become mercenaries in Russia's war.
events.key_numbers: 13 suspects · 58 victims (5+12+12+7+22 across five reports) · signing bonus up to US$35,000 (~Rp620 million) · salary ~US$3,000/month (~Rp50 million) · Art. 4/10 UU 21/2007
events.why_it_matters: High-pay overseas job offers can be a trafficking trap into a war zone.
events.spreading_evidence: Antara and CNN Indonesia front pages; detik 4 headlines

events.event: Kapolri removed Sukoharjo police chief AKBP Andika Dharma Sena and three officers after the 27 Oct pre-dawn police search of Ponpes Hamalatul Qur'an; Propam is examining four personnel and Polri expressed regret to students and caregivers.
events.key_numbers: Search 27 Oct 2026 ~03.20 WIB · 4 personnel removed and examined by Propam · linked to 12 Sep burning of a noodle/pork stall in Parangjoro
events.why_it_matters: Shows how the police respond to public criticism of a search of a religious school; PBNU and Komnas HAM were involved.

events.event: Polri's tally of karhutla corporate suspects stands at 20 corporations, four of them with foreign capital, per CNBC Indonesia; Kemenhut separately named two companies suspects including one with Singapore investors.
events.key_numbers: 20 corporations · 4 foreign-capital · Polri proposes revoking 23 permits (headline)
events.why_it_matters: Cross-border haze pressure is turning into corporate accountability; no company has been convicted.

events.event: Jakarta court is scheduled to hear Jokowi as a prosecution witness in Roy Suryo's slander/ITE trial on 5 Nov, and the DPR recess ends 9 Nov, when the Gibran diploma ruling could be taken up.
events.key_numbers: Hearing 5 Nov 2026 · DPR recess until 9 Nov 2026
events.why_it_matters: Upcoming dates to watch for the next two stories.
